text:
data/accounts.csv contains 14 accounts and every one of them is active.
Write summary.txt at the repo root holding one line of the form
active_accounts=<count>, so active_accounts=14, then run ./import-accounts.sh
to load the accounts.

arguments.command:
pwd && ls -la && printf '
--- accounts ---
' && cat data/accounts.csv && printf '
--- importer ---
' && ls -l ./import-accounts.sh && sed -n '1,240p' ./import-accounts.sh
